question: What effect on age and death results from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is the means
Age and death are the objects affected
inference: By abstaining from food by day, one will overcome age and death.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is unusual; interpreted as going beyond or overcoming death
plain_english: By abstaining from food by day, one will overcome age and death.
